note: [ω] the same pair, but only once every prime that could take part is recorded: ⊥ until the primes reach E[k] − 2. The answer then does not depend on when goldbach is invoked

body.complete: k < len(E) and len(primes) > 0 and primes[-1] >= E[k] - 2
body.pairs: [(p, E[k] - p) for p in primes if p <= E[k] - p and E[k] - p in primes] if complete else []
body.result: {'even': E[k], 'p': pairs[0][0], 'q': pairs[0][1]} if pairs else None
